title: What is an AI agent? A plain definition | 50agents
description: An AI agent is software with a goal, instructions and tools that decides on each run which steps to take. A plain definition and a real example.
definition: An AI agent is software given a goal, instructions and tools, which decides on each run which steps to take.
Unlike a fixed automation, it reads the situation first: which deal went quiet, what to say.

example.ask: Set up an AI agent that finds my HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days every weekday at 9:00 and drafts a follow-up email for me to approve
example.why: Each weekday it judges which deals went quiet and what to write.
